sections.Profile:
"Rocky" is a pinball machine by Gottlieb, released in September 1982. It features an unusual layout with five flippers and 11 drop targets, themed around the "Rocky" film franchise. The machine offers a large playfield, speech, a version of the Rocky theme music, and unique gameplay elements like a kickback between the flippers. Only 1,504 units were produced, making it a rare and notable example of early 80s pinball machines.
